free_cases_pool.title: Case #105 — The Phantom Chime of Room 302

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: I was walking down the 3F B-Wing hallway right around 5:00 PM. Room 302 was pitch dark, but I heard a soft chime melody floating from inside...

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: @Yuki_Library Wait, Room 302? Isn't that the empty homeroom that's locked after afternoon club practice?

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: Class 2-A is on the 2nd floor right below B-Wing! We didn't hear anything during 6th period, but the afternoon light was glowing super bright outside.

timeline.author: Anon_Sleuth
timeline.message: A phantom tune in a locked classroom? Now this is a proper Sakuraoka mystery!

timeline.author: NightOwl_Student
timeline.message: Logging this on my watch list. Will check the BBS tomorrow morning to see if anyone else noticed it.

timeline.author: Ren_Track
timeline.message: Good morning! Track team lap finished. Walked past 3F B-Wing and Room 302 is locked tight like usual.

timeline.author: Hina_Class1A
timeline.message: Good morning seniors! Is it true that Room 302 is haunted by an old music student?

timeline.author: Sora_Drama
timeline.message: Ooh, a ghost story? Drama club could turn this into a play for the festival!

timeline.author: Kenji_Gym
timeline.message: Let's not jump to ghosts just yet. Maybe someone left a phone or speaker in there on a timer?

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: Lunch break update: Nekomi and I checked with the music teacher! The upright pianos were all moved down to the basement storage room last month!

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi peered through Room 302's door glass! No instruments inside at all, just stacked desks! So where is the chime coming from?!

timeline.author: Mina_StarClub
timeline.message: Setting up equipment in the science room across the yard later today. I'll keep an eye on 3F B-Wing.

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: Class 2-A is on the case! Pay attention to the exact time and lighting whenever anyone hears the song!

timeline.author: Aoi
timeline.message: I hear it right now from the courtyard! It's a sweet, warm lullaby playing right as the golden evening light hits B-Wing!

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: We're down in our Light Music room and we can hear it echoing across the courtyard too!

timeline.author: Daiki_Pres
timeline.message: Student Council Notice: Please do not loiter near the 3F B-Wing corridor past curfew.

timeline.author: Anon_Sleuth
timeline.message: Day 2 morning check on the BBS! Still thinking about that melody from yesterday afternoon.

timeline.author: Ren_Track
timeline.message: Day 2 morning run complete. The staff room key box for Room 302 was checked—no student borrowed the key all week.

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: So if the door stays locked, the sound source has to be something sitting right inside that 3F window!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: I walked past during 2nd period break. Pitch silent in the morning.

timeline.author: Hina_Class1A
timeline.message: So it only plays in the afternoon? That's super specific!

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: Aoi and I walked past 3F B-Wing during lunch. The window of Room 302 catches direct sunlight every late afternoon!

timeline.author: Aoi
timeline.message: Notice board update: The music only starts during the golden hour when the sun gets low in the sky!

timeline.author: Sora_Drama
timeline.message: Tying the music to the angle of the sun? That sounds like poetic theater tech!

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi thinks it's a secret Neko FM broadcast! Maybe a hidden antenna near Room 302?!

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: I searched old school logs in the library. Room 302 was last used for club storage during autumn term.

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: @CatEars_Nekomi We don't have any antennas up on the 3rd floor, silly! But the timing is so specific...

timeline.author: NightOwl_Student
timeline.message: Recording time window: strictly afternoon between 5:00 PM and 5:30 PM.

timeline.author: Mina_StarClub
timeline.message: 5:10 PM: Setting up the telescope in the science room across the yard. The orange glow on Room 302's window glass is super bright right now!

timeline.author: Kenji_Gym
timeline.message: Just walked under B-Wing after gym practice. The chime melody is definitely playing right on cue as the sun dips down!

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: CLUE RECAP: The trigger is tied to the late afternoon SUNSET lighting up Room 302!

timeline.author: Daiki_Pres
timeline.message: Reminder: All hallway investigation logs should be submitted peacefully on the BBS.

timeline.author: NightOwl_Student
timeline.message: Day 3 begins! Mid-week mystery analysis in progress.

timeline.author: Aoi
timeline.message: Good morning! I took notes on yesterday's sightings. The chime only happens when the golden 'SUNSET' beam hits the glass directly!

timeline.author: Ren_Track
timeline.message: Morning track update! Ground team confirmed no sound during sunrise or noon.

timeline.author: Hina_Class1A
timeline.message: So 'SUNSET' is definitely the magic time of day for this mystery!

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi checked the room number tag outside again! It clearly says '302' on the brass door plate!

timeline.author: Sora_Drama
timeline.message: Room 302 has such an iconic ring to it now!

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: Putting the clues together: We have the sky event 'SUNSET' and the room location '302'!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: Wait, so is 'SUNSET' part of the activation code for the mystery?

timeline.author: Anon_Sleuth
timeline.message: If 'SUNSET' is word one and '302' is word two... we might be looking at a combined passcode format!

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: If you join the event keyword 'SUNSET' and room '302' with an underscore, could that be it?!

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: That syntax matches the standard Sakuraoka Event Decoder format perfectly!

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: We still need to confirm what object inside Room 302 is actually making the noise though!

timeline.author: Aoi
timeline.message: Let's observe the window glass closely again during today's evening curfew!

timeline.author: Mina_StarClub
timeline.message: 5:12 PM: The sun reached the exact angle again! The window frame is glowing gold and the melody just started!

timeline.author: Kenji_Gym
timeline.message: Stood right outside Room 302 door just now... you can hear a tiny mechanical click right before the chime plays!

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: A mechanical click?! That means it's an automated device on the windowsill!

timeline.author: NightOwl_Student
timeline.message: Day 4 overnight check! The mystery is unravelling fast!

timeline.author: Ren_Track
timeline.message: Thursday morning bleacher laps done! Looked up at Room 302—something small and reflective is sitting on the interior sill!

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: A reflective object sitting on Room 302's windowsill?!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: Is it a solar-powered gadget? That would explain why it only activates when direct light hits it!

timeline.author: Hina_Class1A
timeline.message: A solar chime gadget! That makes so much sense!

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi used binoculars from the courtyard! It looks like a little decorative desk clock with a solar strip!

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: Wait... a small wooden chime clock with a solar strip on top?! Why does that sound so familiar...

timeline.author: Sora_Drama
timeline.message: Dun dun dun!! Drama unfolds on the BBS!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: @Bass_Sera Hold on, Sera! Is that YOUR clock?!

timeline.author: Aoi
timeline.message: Sera, didn't you say you lost your desk novelty clock during band equipment storage cleanup last week?!

timeline.author: Kenji_Gym
timeline.message: No way haha! Did Light Music accidentally leave their own gear in Room 302?!

timeline.author: Anon_Sleuth
timeline.message: The mystery turns into a lost-and-found search! Classic Sakuraoka High!

timeline.author: Mina_StarClub
timeline.message: 5:15 PM: Telescope view confirms the solar panel caught the light right on schedule!

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi is giggling so hard right now in the clubroom!

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: Sera is searching through her rehearsal notes to double-check!

timeline.author: Daiki_Pres
timeline.message: Student Council will verify the room contents during Friday rounds.

timeline.author: Anon_Sleuth
timeline.message: Friday morning! Time to put all the pieces together before the weekend!

timeline.author: Ren_Track
timeline.message: Friday morning! Everyone in the halls is talking about Sera's missing clock haha!

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: So the formula is almost 100% verified by the whole student body now!

timeline.author: Hina_Class1A
timeline.message: I told all my Class 1-A friends about the SUNSET and 302 clues!

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: Library desk confirmed multiple students asking about passcode submission rules.

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi remembers! Sera set her clock on Room 302's windowsill while helping carry cable boxes!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: She left it right where the afternoon light hits! Perfect accidental mystery trap!

timeline.author: Sora_Drama
timeline.message: This is genuinely the cutest resolution ever.

timeline.author: Aoi
timeline.message: So whenever the low SUNSET light hits Room 302, the solar panel gets enough power to play its chime!

timeline.author: Kenji_Gym
timeline.message: Mystery solved by logic and observations!

timeline.author: Daiki_Pres
timeline.message: Student Council: We will unlock Room 302 on Sunday evening during weekly rounds to verify.

timeline.author: Mina_StarClub
timeline.message: 5:15 PM Friday chime recorded! Clear audio tone confirmed.

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: I am preparing my official apology post for Sunday's resolution thread...

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: Don't be embarrassed Sera! It gave the whole school a fun case to solve together!

timeline.author: NightOwl_Student
timeline.message: Friday night thread locking in. Preparing for weekend chatter.

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: Have a great weekend everyone! See you on the BBS!

timeline.author: Anon_Sleuth
timeline.message: Saturday morning BBS lounge check! Case #105 pre-solve summary looking super solid!

timeline.author: Hina_Class1A
timeline.message: Weekend study session complete! Logging into Sakuraoka BBS to hang out.

timeline.author: Ren_Track
timeline.message: Saturday morning track practice done. The campus courtyard is so serene today.

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: Reminding everyone that the final code drops officially on Sunday!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: Listening to Neko FM weekend playlist right now.

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: The library is quiet today. Perfect weather for reading.

timeline.author: Aoi
timeline.message: Saturday chatter! The clue components are 100% verified: SUNSET + 302!

timeline.author: Sora_Drama
timeline.message: I'm already hyping up my club members to enter the passcode on Sunday!

timeline.author: Kenji_Gym
timeline.message: Weekend volleyball drill complete. Ready for Sunday reveal!

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi can't wait for Sunday when Sera officially confesses on the BBS!

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: Nekomi, please don't tease me on the main feed forever!

timeline.author: Mina_StarClub
timeline.message: Clear skies tonight for weekend stargazing!

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: Get your passcodes ready for the Mystery Decoder tab on Sunday!

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: Class 2-A investigation team will post the official closing report tomorrow evening!

timeline.author: Daiki_Pres
timeline.message: Have a restful weekend everyone!

timeline.author: NightOwl_Student
timeline.message: Saturday night sign-off. Countdown to Day 7 solve!

timeline.author: Anon_Sleuth
timeline.message: Sunday morning! Case #105 final resolution day!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: Sunday homework finished! Waiting for the official case closing report on the BBS!

timeline.author: Hina_Class1A
timeline.message: Ready to claim my Seven Wonders Sleuth badge today!

timeline.author: Ren_Track
timeline.message: Rest day complete. Gear packed for Monday morning track runs.

timeline.author: Yumi_Class2A
timeline.message: Checking in on the BBS while getting my school uniform ready for tomorrow!

timeline.author: Yuki_Library
timeline.message: Sunday library drop box cleared for tomorrow morning.

timeline.author: Sora_Drama
timeline.message: The grand finale of Case #105 is almost here!

timeline.author: Kenji_Gym
timeline.message: Ready to log the master code on the Decoder tab!

timeline.author: Bass_Sera
timeline.message: CONFESSION POST: I am so embarrassed!! It was my solar chime clock sitting in Room 302 the whole time! Every time the SUNSET hit the glass at 5:00 PM, it powered up and played its melody!

timeline.author: CatEars_Nekomi
timeline.message: Nekomi reclaimed the clock with the custodian! MYSTERY SOLVED!!

timeline.author: Aoi
timeline.message: Great job everyone in Class 2-A and across all grades for gathering the clues!

timeline.author: Akari_M
timeline.message: OFFICIAL PASSCODE RELEASE: Enter SUNSET_302 into the Mystery Decoder tab right now to claim your 'Seven Wonders Sleuth' badge!

timeline.author: Hiro_Class2B
timeline.message: Entered SUNSET_302 and unlocked my badge! Such a sweet mystery solution!

timeline.author: Mina_StarClub
timeline.message: Badge unlocked! The solar clock chime mystery is officially solved!

timeline.author: Daiki_Pres
timeline.message: Case #105 is officially closed. Next weekly campus event rotation begins tomorrow at midnight!

timeline.author: Hina_Class1A
timeline.message: Goodnight everyone! Can't wait for next week's mystery event!

timeline.author: NightOwl_Student
timeline.message: Case #105 complete! SUNSET_302 redeemed. Preparing for Case #106 reset!
